home.title: Home - AI Interview Platform
home.h1: Run the interview. Read the report.
home.lead: Upload a résumé, interview by voice or text, get a scored report.
home.s1_p: Text is pulled from the PDF and parsed into skills, work history, education and projects.
home.s2_p: Technical, behavioural and situational questions are generated from that profile, in the candidate's language.
home.s3_p: Questions come one at a time, with follow-ups when an answer needs one.
home.s4_p: Each answer is scored, then rolled into a report with a hiring recommendation.
